events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Three decades on, the music world remembers Tupac Shakur. His impact on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering a Legend
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, we lost the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His influence on rock music remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us the legendary 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this iconic album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Trailblazer
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer whose voice continues to captivate.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Biblical
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the one and only Liam Gallagher, celebrating his 54th birthday today. Still sounding biblical!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Released 55 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to imagine. Its message is still as relevant and powerful today.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the iPod changed everything. Remember stuffing your favourite 1,000 songs in your pocket?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Favourites
angles.copy: License to thrill! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Queen frontman and music icon Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Unmatched Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles pushed boundaries with 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed pop music forever.

events.title: John Lennon: Remembering a Legend
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician, songwriter, and peace activist continues to resonate globally.
